_readme: Spec 67. Atlas's avatar mode: an opt-in stage inside the Atlas panel, toggled from the panel header (assets/js/agent-avatar.js, lazy-loaded by agent-widget.js). Avatar 'Sam' + voice 'Puck', picked by hand in Console -> Agent Platform -> Studio -> Stream realtime (model gemini-3.8-live, Live Avatar panel). Only the greeting ships: Atlas's own prompt chips already cover the topics, so the avatar doesn't duplicate them. Clips are recorded by agents/atlas/app/dev_scripts/record_avatar_clips.py, then re-encoded for the web (see the spec).
idleCaption: Generated with Gemini. Tap my face to replay.
